panels.title: Urządzenia online
panels.description: Liczba różnych urządzeń widocznych w sieci w przedziałach 5-minutowych.

targets.queryText:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / 300) * 300 AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mac) AS "Urządzenia online"
FROM device_observations
WHERE online = 1 AND ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', ts) AS INTEGER) / 300) * 300 AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT mac) AS "Urządzenia online"
FROM device_observations
WHERE online = 1 AND ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Urządzenia – ostatnio widziane
panels.description: Wszystkie znane urządzenia, ostatnio widziane na górze.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, d.mac) AS "Urządzenie",
  d.mac AS "MAC",
  d.ip AS "IP",
  d.vendor AS "Producent",
  p.name AS "Właściciel",
  CASE WHEN d.last_seen >= datetime('now', '-5 minutes') THEN 'W sieci' ELSE 'Poza siecią' END AS "Stan",
  CAST(strftime('%s', d.last_seen) AS INTEGER) AS time
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = d.person_id
ORDER BY d.last_seen DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, d.mac) AS "Urządzenie",
  d.mac AS "MAC",
  d.ip AS "IP",
  d.vendor AS "Producent",
  p.name AS "Właściciel",
  CASE WHEN d.last_seen >= datetime('now', '-5 minutes') THEN 'W sieci' ELSE 'Poza siecią' END AS "Stan",
  CAST(strftime('%s', d.last_seen) AS INTEGER) AS time
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.id = d.person_id
ORDER BY d.last_seen DESC

panels.title: Sygnał Wi-Fi wg godziny doby
panels.description: Średni i najsłabszy RSSI zgłaszany przez router dla każdego urządzenia w danej godzinie doby (czas lokalny komputera). Im bliżej 0, tym lepiej: powyżej −60 dBm dobry, poniżej −75 dBm słaby.

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, o.mac) AS "Urządzenie",
  CAST(strftime('%H', o.ts, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) AS "Godzina",
  ROUND(AVG(o.signal), 1) AS "Średni sygnał (dBm)",
  MIN(o.signal) AS "Najsłabszy (dBm)",
  COUNT(*) AS "Próbek"
FROM device_observations o
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = o.mac
WHERE o.signal IS NOT NULL AND o.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND o.ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY o.mac, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(d.label, d.hostname, o.mac) AS "Urządzenie",
  CAST(strftime('%H', o.ts, 'localtime') AS INTEGER) AS "Godzina",
  ROUND(AVG(o.signal), 1) AS "Średni sygnał (dBm)",
  MIN(o.signal) AS "Najsłabszy (dBm)",
  COUNT(*) AS "Próbek"
FROM device_observations o
LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.mac = o.mac
WHERE o.signal IS NOT NULL AND o.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND o.ts <= datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY o.mac, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
